場合があります。皮膚に異常を感じたときは、すみやかにご使用をおやめください。 ●耳の近くで使用してはいけません。 誤って使用すると、聴覚を
損なう恐れがあります。●本商品には電子部品を使用しております。ペースメーカーをご使用の方は、本商品を身体に近づけないようご注意ください。
●LEDの光の点滅を見続けないでください。 気分が悪くなったりする恐れがあります。 ●電池(別売り)、電池ぶたなどの誤飲事故に注意して
ください。《電池を誤使用すると発熱・ 破裂 液漏れの恐れがあります。 下記に注意してください》 二次電池 (充電式電池) は、 絶対に使用しない

blocks.translation:
• To the purchaser: Read this carefully.
• This product is for ages 15 and older. Do not give it to children under the intended age.
• This product contains small parts. Keep it away from young children so they do not accidentally swallow them; there is a risk of choking.
• Wearing the belt for long periods may cause rash or itching from sweat. If you notice any skin abnormality, stop using it immediately.
• Do not use this product near the ear. Incorrect use may damage hearing.
• This product contains electronic components. If you use a pacemaker, keep this product away from your body.
• Do not stare at blinking LED lights. Continuous viewing may cause nausea or other symptoms.
• Be careful of accidental swallowing of batteries (sold separately) or the battery cover. Misuse of batteries can cause overheating, rupture or leakage; follow the precautions below.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or batteries of different types.
• Insert batteries with the correct polarity (+/−).
• After playing, always turn off the switch and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a physician. If fluid gets on skin or clothes, wash with water.
• When disposing of the product or batteries, follow your local municipal waste disposal instructions.

blocks.translation:
• This product is precision-made. Do not apply excessive force or drop it, as it may break.
• This product contains precision electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in very hot or very cold places.
• Dispose of plastic packing material immediately after opening.
• This product has painted surfaces. When storing it, avoid contact with other items (plastic products, furniture, sofas). Colors may transfer.
• Do not pull or bend movable parts or attachment parts forcefully in the wrong direction.
• Some voice lines may have different intonation or may be difficult to hear because of the product's characteristics.
• Do not set or insert any item other than the compatible product into Dainoburesu -MEMORIAL EDITION-. Doing so may cause malfunction or damage.
